err.routerDown: Router is unreachable. Ensure you are on the same network and api-ssl is enabled under IP > Services.
banner.routerDown: Router is unreachable. New cards will wait until it reconnects; your accounts remain active.
banner.netDown: Internet down for {m} minutes. Routers connected and sales continue; cloud backup will resume when online.
banner.ok: All systems online. Last backup moments ago.
dlg.overpay.title: Amount exceeds balance due
dlg.overpay.body: Received {paid} while due is {due}. The excess {extra} will be credited to distributor balance.
dlg.overLimit.title: {name} exceeds credit limit
dlg.overLimit.body: Balance owed is {owed} and credit limit is {limit}. Are you sure you want to deliver new cards?
dlg.correct.title: Cancel settlement of {amount}?
dlg.correct.body: We do not delete transactions. An offsetting reversal entry will be recorded, preserving full audit log.
dlg.kick.title: Disconnect card {code}?
dlg.kick.body: The customer will be disconnected immediately. Remaining time stays on the card.
dlg.return.title: Return cards from {name}
dlg.return.body: Currently holds {n} cards. Returned cards will be disabled on the router.
dlg.dispute.title: Open dispute with {name}?
dlg.dispute.body: Balance remains unchanged. The dispute is recorded in statement and appears in today's tasks until resolved.
dlg.reprint.title: Reprint batch {no} again?
dlg.reprint.body: The same codes will be printed, and the print count is logged. Use only when paper was damaged.
dlg.printCheck.title: Did printing succeed?
dlg.printCheck.body: Batch printed {n} times; each reprint is recorded.
dlg.restore.title: Restore backup from {when}?
dlg.restore.body: Transactions newer than the backup will be lost. A backup of the current state will be taken before restoring.
toast.settledExtra: Recorded {paid}. Overpayment {extra} added to distributor balance.
toast.correctNone: Last entry is not a settlement; nothing to reverse.
toast.returnDown: Returned {n} cards; will be disabled when router reconnects.
toast.import: Imported {n} cards, marked as direct sale until assigned to a distributor.
batch.partial.title: {router} confirmed {ok} cards out of {total}
batch.partial.body: {n} cards pending. Batch is saved and will not print until confirmed.
batch.resendDown: Router is still unreachable. Batch is safe; retry when online.
batch.done.body: {n} cards entrusted to {name}. Debt is incurred when cards are used.
home.empty.title: No tasks today
status.searchPlaceholder: Search for a card, press Enter
network.title: Network
network.mockSub: Mock router for testing. Connect a real router when ready.
network.queueBusy: {n} operations queued for router, saved locally
network.sessionsFailSub: Router unreachable. Data is safe and will refresh once online.
network.connect.title: Connect Router
network.connect.body: Your device must be on the same local network as the router. Enable api-ssl under IP > Services, and use a user account with limited privileges, not admin.
extend.title: Extend Time for Card: {code}
extend.body: Select additional uptime to add to this card on the router. Uptime will extend immediately and the customer stays connected.
extend.label: Additional Duration
card.title: Card Check
card.missingHelp: Check spelling, or ask the distributor for the batch number.
card.routerUnchecked: Router unreachable; result shown from local log only.
settings.title: Settings
account.title: Distributors
batch.title: Cards
reports.title: Reports
login.title: Log In
login.createOwner.title: Create Owner PIN
login.createOwner.body: The PIN protects your accounts. Enter it whenever you open the app. You can add a technician PIN later from settings.
login.reset.title: Reset PIN
login.reset.body: For the network owner. Send these two codes to support to receive a one-time recovery key. Technicians must request a new PIN from the owner.
login.err.copyFailed: Could not copy. Please write the codes manually.
auth.err.auth_locked: Too many attempts. Wait {held} seconds and try again.
auth.err.auth_inactive: This user is suspended. The network owner can reactivate it.
auth.err.auth_self: Cannot suspend yourself while logged in.
auth.err.reset_invalid: Invalid recovery key. Ensure you copied it completely.
auth.err.reset_other_device: This key is for another device.
auth.err.reset_wrong_request: This key is for an older request. Send the current request code to support.
auth.err.reset_expired: This key has expired. Request a new one from support.
auth.err.default: An error occurred, please try again.
setup.connect.title: Connect Router
setup.connect.sub: Your computer must be on the same network as the router. Enable api-ssl under IP > Services, and use a limited-privilege account, not admin.
setup.connect.ok: Connected to router. Found {n} hotspot profiles.
setup.cats.title: Categories & Prices
setup.cats.sub: Found these categories on the router. Review prices before continuing; leave wholesale empty for categories you do not sell.
setup.cats.errAtLeastOne: Enter wholesale price for at least one category.
setup.cats.errUptime: Invalid uptime format for {name}. Format like 1h, 3h, or 1d.
setup.dist.title: Distributors & Balances
setup.dist.sub: Add a distributor, and any existing debt/balance. You can also skip and add them later.
setup.dist.name: Distributor Name
setup.test.title: Test a Card Before Printing
setup.test.sub: Verify the connection works properly before generating your first real batch.
setup.test.unconfirmed: Router did not confirm card {code}. Ensure it is reachable and try again.
setup.test.prompt: Did you test it on your phone? Did it work?
setup.test.hint: Verify Hotspot is running on the router, profile has valid rate/uptime limits, and try again.
setup.test.ready: Nuqta is ready. Generate your first batch.
